AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: cross-pollinate
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Cross two strains of the same species. Your botanist raises several offspring; you keep one and get seed packets of it. Offspring take one allele per locus from each parent, so recessive traits can surface.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: self-pollinate
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Pollinate a strain with itself. Each generation of selfing fixes more loci, which is how purebred lines that breed true are made. Also uncovers hidden recessive traits.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: propagate cuttings
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Root cuttings from one seed packet's plant: 1 packet becomes 4 identical packets. Can repeat until a chosen number of packets is in stock.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: sequence genome
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Read the full genotype of a strain: both alleles of every locus and carried genes. Its alleles and genes join the allele library. The packet is returned.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: archive strain
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Store an analysed strain's genome in the gene bank. Archived strains can be printed by a seed synthesizer without seed. The packet is returned.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: micropropagate
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Grow plantlets from tissue samples: 1 packet becomes 12 identical packets. Can repeat until a chosen number of packets is in stock.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: induce mutations
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Irradiate seed. Produces several mutants, each with 1 to 3 changed loci (mostly upward, up to level +6) and a chance of a new industrial gene such as bioluminescence. Choose one to keep. With genetic analysis researched the mutants' genotypes are read on the spot.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: colchicine treatment
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Double the plant's chromosome sets. The result is polyploid: +6 genome capacity, so it can carry more improvements without burden.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: edit locus
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Set both alleles of one locus to an exact level. You can only write levels your allele library already contains (from any analysed strain of any species), up to +8. Lowering a locus frees genome capacity.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: splice gene
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Insert two copies of a known or synthetic gene, from any species.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: knock out gene
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Remove a gene from a strain, freeing the capacity it used.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: synthesize seeds
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Print 10 seed packets of an archived strain from gene reagent. Needs a powered gene bank and no colonist. Can repeat until a chosen number of packets is in stock.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: synthesize allele
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Write a locus to any level up to +10, with no library needed.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: splice exotic gene
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Insert any known or synthetic gene, including ultratech genes such as chemosynthesis, deathless tissue and phytomining.

AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.label: install synthetic chromosome
AdvancedPlantGenetics.GeneticOperationDe.description: Add a synthetic chromosome: +12 genome capacity.
